digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output and prompt caching
propositions: Live Anthropic structured cache canary with identical system prefix over two calls demonstrates write/read cache behavior with 10759 input tokens, 10697 cache write on call 1, and 10697 cache read on call 2, all with exactly one model request per call

Live Bedrock structured cache canary with identical system prefix shows 10747 input tokens, 10685 cache write on call 1, and 10685 cache read on call 2, matching Anthropic's cache pattern with one request per call

Observed accounting on both providers matches the documented contract: exactly one outer run per well-formed first response, complete-or-omit branch directly traced, no transport retry or downgrade fallback exercised

Mixed-provider fallback chains collapse to prompt_cache_style=none due to incompatible cache keys between Anthropic and Bedrock, creating zero cache write/read on multi-candidate runs despite individual provider support
